newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London flat, rail shares sought.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London flat, rail shares sought.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were little changed on Monday in what dealers called minimal trade after worries about the approaching general election dampened activity in Tokyo.
The Nikkei/Ise 50 index was up 1.16 points at 1,435.77 by 1322 GMT after the Nikkei in Tokyo gained 0.29 percent to end at 21,029.25 points in the lowest volume for the year to date.
"It's been the quietest we've seen for a long time...and we don't expect to move anywhere on this volume," said one dealer.
Traders noted some interest in the transportation sector, chiefly railway company JR East.
"The stock came off a lot recently on selling after JR West was listed but it's now hit a level where bargain hunters are coming back," one trader said.
Among other movers, airline ANA was slightly weaker. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 4367
